description: Lists published client references (case studies) from meom.fi, newest first: client, page URL, summary, measured results as stated on the page (empty when the page states none), the page's own text about the client and about the project, what MEOM did, platform, industries (only when the reference is tagged with one; often empty) and tags. Client size is not available. Optionally filter by a search term, a tag such as "WordPress" or "HubSpot", or only references with results.

has_results.description: When true, only references that state measured results.

lang.description: Content language: "fi" (Finnish, default) or "en" (English). Not every page has an English version.

query.description: Optional search term matched against reference titles and text.

name: meom-public-list-references
title: List MEOM client references
